gates: Fixed follower traverses every leg and demonstrates manipulation-ready arrivals
Freeze route, tracking interface and verifiers
At least four additional durable checkpoint slots verified

parent.selection_caveat: Latest recoverable V7 full state; V7 update 64 had better development arrivals but has no preserved optimizer state. Resume from recoverability, not a claim of being best.

training.method: Supervised imitation from physical reference-follower rollouts, plus measured contact-profile trials

retention.estimate_basis: Four times the measured 437565045-byte parent full state; future sizes may differ

evaluation_arms.A: Parent 96 + existing route and original interface
evaluation_arms.B: Parent 96 + frozen new reference and new tracking interface
evaluation_arms.C: Post-trained weights + exactly the same reference/interface as B
evaluation_arms.D: Fixed reference follower + fixed, training-calibrated contact profiles

selection: Development only: first minimize falls, edge/contact violations; then maximize full-sequence and navigation success; then successful-route travel time, excess distance and reversals. Do not automatically select update 64. Open held-out scenarios once after selection freeze.
wall_clock_estimate: 2-3 hours for data, training, checkpoint evaluation and demo export after the gates pass; a planning estimate, not a service guarantee

sponsor_use.Tinker: Actual forward/backward + optimizer updates only after storage gate
sponsor_use.Modal: Bounded physical rollouts and matched inference comparisons
sponsor_use.past.dev: Source-verified cross-identity evidence handoffs after checkpoints

presentation.checkpoint_animation: Recorded continuous episodes; preserve regressions; no root animation or stage resets
presentation.claims: No motor-level gait training, hardware transfer or causal memory/search benefit without additional evidence
